description: Look up syllables, frequency, optional definitions and pronunciation for supplied English words or phrases. Accepts 1–100 inputs; processes the first ten sequentially within one 20-second deadline. Returns indexed outcomes for every input, preserving duplicates, failures and unprocessed entries. Query echo may contain guessed metadata; never substitutes spelling corrections.

include_definitions.description: Include upstream definitions; senses may make the response substantially larger.

include_ipa.description: Request IPA tags and imply pronunciation; raw ARPAbet and IPA tags may both be returned.

include_pronunciation.description: Request raw pronunciation tags; ARPAbet stress digits are 0 unstressed, 1 primary, 2 secondary. May be guessed or omitted.

words.description: Words or phrases in caller order; first ten are processed and the rest explicitly unprocessed.

items.description: Nonblank target word or phrase, at most 200 characters; surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

name: datamuse_get_word_info

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

outcomes.description: One complete indexed outcome per supplied input; no rows or values are truncated.

row.description: Complete raw query-echo row with upstream spelling preserved.

defHeadword.description: Optional upstream headword associated with definitions.

defs.description: Optional raw definitions; tabs and whitespace are preserved.

numSyllables.description: Optional upstream syllable count, which may be guessed.

score.description: Optional upstream ranking score; not confidence or frequency.

tags.description: Optional raw metadata tags, including unknown tags.

word.description: Upstream word or phrase, preserved exactly.

status.description: A matching query echo was returned.

oneOf.description: Failed lookup with a recovery action.

reason.description: missing_query_echo, invalid_upstream_response, an upstream or pacer reason, or upstream_failure.

status.description: This input failed; other inputs may succeed.

oneOf.description: Input left unprocessed by a bound.

reason.description: Ten-input processing cap or whole-call deadline.

title: Datamuse Get Word Info
